summary: The contract closely tracks the single-source evidence pack (story.md only, no attachments): every acceptance criterion, rule and endpoint quotes its cited line verbatim with no added, dropped or inverted conditions, layers are assigned consistently with whether a sentence is web-shop-only, API-only or spans both, and every requirement-bearing (●) line in the pack is captured in the coverage ledger with no gaps. Gaps G6 and G7 are honestly distinguished as 'assumed' vs. 'found-in-requirement' respectively, and both resolutions are sound, disclosed inferences grounded in cited lines rather than invented behaviour; G4's AUT-discovered mechanism for GET /products/{id} is corroborated by the cited hardening probes.
